title: Renewal and Expiry of Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions (Billing Note)
content:
A Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product whose automatic renewal is on renews on the day after its end date for another term of the subscription's term length in calendar months, at the price the subscription's renewal price basis gives, charged on that day; with automatic renewal off it expires.

## Billing points

- **Day of renewal and of the charge.** The day after the end date. The renewal charge is booked on that same day.
- **Price.** The price given by the subscription's renewal price basis, which the subscription settings set as the current list price.
- **Length of the renewed term.** The subscription's term, in calendar months, counted again from the renewal.
- **Status needed.** A renewal is recorded only while the subscription is active, as its status stands on the company's records for that subscription before the renewal is recorded. A subscription in purchased, expired or cancelled status is not renewed.
- **Expiry.** A subscription whose automatic renewal is off expires when its end date has passed, and its closing date is the day after the end date.
- **The renewal setting.** The subscriber may switch automatic renewal on or off at any time while the subscription is active. A new subscription starts with the subscription's default renewal setting.

## Branches at the end of a term

| Automatic renewal on the record | Subscription status | Outcome on the day after the end date |
|---|---|---|
| On | Active | Renews for another term at the renewal price, charged that day |
| Off | Active | Expires; closing date is that day |

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A subscription with a hypothetical end date of 31 May, automatic renewal on and status active renews on 1 June, and the renewal price is charged on 1 June. The same subscription with automatic renewal off expires, with 1 June as its closing date. A subscriber who switches automatic renewal off on 20 May, while the subscription is still active, therefore sees the expiry outcome.
